# Release notes

Updates to the apps, the API and the developer tools, newest first.

### October 22, 2026

- Added a **batch mode** for the messages endpoint, described in the [batch guide](https://example.com/guides/batch-mode), that accepts up to 10,000 requests per batch
- The desktop app now remembers window size and position between launches

### October 21, 2026

- Improved the usage dashboard with per-project breakdowns
  - Projects can be filtered by label
  - Exports now include the project name

### October 20, 2026

- Extended the file upload limit for conversations, see [uploading files](/en/docs/build-with-claude/files) for the new sizes
- Fixed an issue where long conversation titles were cut off on mobile

### October 9, 2026

- Added a keyboard shortcut for switching between recent conversations
